_meta.purpose: Verified Amazon products per category. Identity only: no prices, ever.
_meta.why_two_sources: The thing that found the product does not vouch for it. A SERP result is an advertisement; a catalogue record is a fact.
_meta.price_policy: No price is stored or displayed. The Associates Operating Agreement permits displaying price data only from the Product Advertising API refreshed within 24 hours, and static prices go stale silently.
_meta.recheck_policy: Re-run this script before any campaign or quarterly. Products get discontinued and ASINs get repurposed; a manifest is a claim with a date on it.
